messages:
kevin: FYI — seeing weird duplicate quota/charge counts in Console for SSE clients after the edge-proxy rollout at 03:15. Trace attached.

maria: Can you paste the minimal repro logs? is this only resume flows or plain reconnects too?

kevin: Minimal repro (from the client side):
```bash
curl -H "Accept: text/event-stream" "https://api.redwood.example/stream?v=abc"
```
Server logs (redacted):
```
[2026-03-22T03:16:01Z] edge-proxy: incoming request, X-Resume-TTL=30s, X-Resume-Token=abc123
[2026-03-22T03:16:01Z] edge-proxy: normalized header X-Resume-TTL -> 30000
[2026-03-22T03:16:01Z] stream-handler: resume window lookup token=abc123 ttl=30000s -> treated as NEW session (shard change)
[2026-03-22T03:16:01Z] billing: emit resume_charge tenant=acct-42 tokens=1
[2026-03-22T03:16:02Z] stream-handler: legitimate resume accepted token=abc123 previous_session_id=xyz -> emit resume_charge tenant=acct-42 tokens=1
```

kevin: TL;DR: proxy normalized the TTL header from an ISO-like "30s" to the integer 30000 (milliseconds?) and the runtime interpreted it as 30000 seconds, which changed routing/shard selection and caused the same resume to be counted twice.

tina: ugh. That header rewrite smells like our header-normalization middleware trying to be helpful. We have a patch that normalizes times to seconds, but looks like it assumed all numbers are millis.

deploy-bot: edge-proxy v2.4 deployed to us-west-2 at 2026-03-22T03:15:30Z (sha: a1b2c3d).

maria: Is this only happening when proxy is in the path (vs direct to origin)? Any console delta for direct connections?

kevin: Direct-to-origin (bypass) shows single resume_charge as expected. Only through the new proxy path we get the duplicate.

sre-oncall: We should treat this as both a billing + routing bug. Impact: multiple tenants showed +0.5–2% resume double-counts for a 10m window after deploy. Alert created: #INC-2026-131.

tina: Quick fix options:
1) Stop rewriting X-Resume-TTL header and forward as-is (fast).
2) Normalize with an explicit units parser: accept suffixes (s/m/ms) and refuse ambiguous pure numbers.
3) Add a runtime defensive check: if TTL > 86400s, clamp/ignore and log telemetry.

maria: 2 + 3 please. We need good telemetry so Console can flag suspected proxy-rewrites with a badge instead of just counts.

console-ui: For Console UX: we can add a new alert tag "suspected-header-rewrite" and surface a small tooltip explaining duplication risk. Would you prefer an automatic dedupe in billing pipeline or a visible warning?

kevin: My vote: short-term do a defensive dedupe in billing (idempotency window based on resume token + request id), long-term fix the proxy. Dedupe should be opt-out for enterprise customers.

tina: Agreed. I'll open a PR for the proxy parser and a rollback flag. PR will include unit tests for TTL parsing.

maria: For telemetry, add a boolean flag in the resume trace: "header_rewrite_detected" and emit to traces/console with sampling 1% default, 100% for any tenant with >0.2% resume anomalies.

sre-oncall: Also add a synthetic canary test: create 1000 short-lived SSE resumes through the proxy and assert billing delta < 0.2%. Add to nightly regression harness.

kevin: Filed issue: https://redwood.internal/issue/INF-4528 — includes logs, affected tenants, and suggested rollback. I'll attach a small repro harness.

tina: WIP patch -> gist:```go
// parseResumeTTL parses values like 30s, 500ms, 1m. Reject bare ints unless explicit units.
func parseResumeTTL(h string) (time.Duration, error) {
    if strings.HasSuffix(h, "ms") || strings.HasSuffix(h, "s") || strings.HasSuffix(h, "m") {
        return time.ParseDuration(h)
    }
    return 0, fmt.Errorf("ambiguous ttl, require unit")
}
```

maria: Nice. Add changelog note: "edge-proxy: strict resume TTL parsing to avoid routing/charge duplication"

console-ui: I'll add the UI badge and expose a drilldown that links to the trace id when header_rewrite_detected=true.

sre-oncall: Rolling edge-proxy v2.4 -> v2.4.1 (hotfix) with TTL parse fix now. Monitor dashboard for duplicates and alert on >0.5% delta.

kevin: Thanks. Follow-ups:
- tina to open PR + rollback flag (ETA 1h)
- maria to add trace flag + sampling update (ETA 2h)
- console-ui to add badge and drilldown (ETA next sprint but add temporary banner)
- kevin to run synthetic nightly canary once we have hotfix

maria: tagging the rollout notes and billing team. :thumbsup:

kevin: closing loop here — will post results once synthetic run finishes.

deploy-bot: edge-proxy v2.4.1 hotfix deployed to us-west-2 at 2026-03-22T04:05:12Z (sha: d4e5f6g).

kevin: Synthetic canary done: 1000 resumes through proxy, billing delta = 0.03% (within tolerance). Closing incident.

sre-oncall: Incident INC-2026-131 resolved and postmortem scheduled"
